crossRefs.note: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here, and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”
Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, until he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; in addition to…
and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and Yahweh would not pardon.
Now after the death of Jehoiada, the princes of Judah came, and bowed down to the king. Then the king listened to them.
but they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until Yahweh’s wrath arose…
“Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets…
“I have struck your children in vain. They received no correction. Your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a…
The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
and the rest grabbed his servants, and treated them shamefully, and killed them.
When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.
who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all…
forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them…
For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”
